title: Sad Trombone
blurb: The sad trombone — four descending notes ending in a defeated wah-wah. It's the oldest fail sound in comedy, older than the internet itself, and it still lands every single time. Play it after a bad joke, a failed attempt, or any anticlimax that needs punctuating. This is an original synthesized rendition of the classic womp-womp cadence, free to download and deploy at funerals for dignity.
origin: Original synthesis of the classic descending 'wah wah wah waaah' fail cadence.
